# NEW 2026-11-23 v18.0 Module 18.0-D: O(1) Yearly Hook oe_dyn2_kernel_yearly + Cross-Country Dynastic Prestige & Synthesis Effects (oe_dyn2_, 0 mainline slots, 0 rules, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v180_dynasty_culture.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# =============================================================================
# EXPORTED ZERO-SLOT YEARLY HOOK (called once per year; O(1) self-dedup)
# =============================================================================

oe_dyn2_kernel_yearly = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { global_var:oe_dyn2_ran_y ?= current_year }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_dyn2_ran_y value = current_year }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_dyn2_yearly_runs } }
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_dyn2_yearly_runs value = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			change_global_variable = { name = oe_dyn2_yearly_runs add = 1 }
		}
		oe_dyn2_update_great_dynasties = yes
		oe_dyn2_yearly_dispatch = yes
	}
}

# =============================================================================
# 1. CROSS-COUNTRY DYNASTIC PRESTIGE (8 Great Houses via add_dynasty_modifier)
# =============================================================================

# Dynasty scope. Refreshes cross-country dynastic prestige modifier + country-level aura.
oe_dyn2_refresh_dynasty_prestige = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			any_country_in_dynasty = {
				is_rebel_country = no
				OR = {
					is_great_power = yes
					country_rank = country_rank:rank_empire
					prestige >= 35
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_dynasty_modifier = oe_dyn2_mod_dyn_sovereign_house } }
			add_dynasty_modifier = { modifier = oe_dyn2_mod_dyn_sovereign_house years = 12 mode = replace }
		}
		every_country_in_dynasty = {
			limit = {
				is_rebel_country = no
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_dyn2_mod_great_house_prestige }
			}
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_dyn2_mod_great_house_prestige years = 12 mode = replace }
		}
	}
}

# Global/carrier scope. Evaluates all 8 storied Eurasian dynasties in O(1).
oe_dyn2_update_great_dynasties = {
	if = {
		limit = { dynasty_exists = palaiologos_dynasty }
		dynasty:palaiologos_dynasty = { oe_dyn2_refresh_dynasty_prestige = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { dynasty_exists = borjigin_dynasty }
		dynasty:borjigin_dynasty = { oe_dyn2_refresh_dynasty_prestige = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { dynasty_exists = habsburg_dynasty }
		dynasty:habsburg_dynasty = { oe_dyn2_refresh_dynasty_prestige = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { dynasty_exists = ottomans_dynasty }
		dynasty:ottomans_dynasty = { oe_dyn2_refresh_dynasty_prestige = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { dynasty_exists = rtr_ming_zhu_dynasty }
		dynasty:rtr_ming_zhu_dynasty = { oe_dyn2_refresh_dynasty_prestige = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { dynasty_exists = bagrationi_dynasty }
		dynasty:bagrationi_dynasty = { oe_dyn2_refresh_dynasty_prestige = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { dynasty_exists = valois_dynasty }
		dynasty:valois_dynasty = { oe_dyn2_refresh_dynasty_prestige = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { dynasty_exists = bourbon_dynasty }
		dynasty:bourbon_dynasty = { oe_dyn2_refresh_dynasty_prestige = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			country_exists = c:TIM
			c:TIM = {
				has_ruler = yes
				ruler = { has_dynasty = yes }
			}
		}
		c:TIM = {
			ruler = {
				dynasty = { oe_dyn2_refresh_dynasty_prestige = yes }
			}
		}
	}
}

# =============================================================================
# 2. YEARLY EVENT DISPATCHER (dispatches all 14 visible events oe_dyn2.1..14)
# =============================================================================

oe_dyn2_yearly_dispatch = {
	every_country = {
		limit = { oe_dyn2_is_eligible_realm = yes }

		# Event 1: Imperial House Ascendant (Great Dynasty prestige milestone)
		if = {
			limit = {
				current_year >= 1345
				government_type = government_type:monarchy
				has_ruler = yes
				ruler = { has_dynasty = yes }
				OR = {
					oe_dyn2_is_great_dynasty_member = yes
					AND = {
						prestige >= 45
						country_rank = country_rank:rank_empire
					}
				}
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_dyn2_cd_ev1 }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_dyn2_cd_ev1 years = 28 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_dyn2.1
		}

		# Event 2: Cadet Branch Ambition & Dynastic Settlement
		if = {
			limit = {
				current_year >= 1365
				government_type = government_type:monarchy
				has_ruler = yes
				ruler = {
					has_dynasty = yes
					dynasty = { num_adult_available_dynasty_members >= 2 }
				}
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_dyn2_cd_ev2 }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_dyn2_cd_ev2 years = 26 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_dyn2.2
		}

		# Event 3: Triumph of the Royal Curriculum (Heir Tutoring Milestone)
		if = {
			limit = {
				current_year >= 1350
				has_heir = yes
				heir = { age_in_years >= 12 }
				OR = {
					oe_dyn2_has_elite_heir_education = yes
					prestige >= 35
				}
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_dyn2_cd_ev3 }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_dyn2_cd_ev3 years = 22 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_dyn2.3
		}

		# Event 4: Codification of Imperial Succession (Co-Emperor / Secret Edict Box)
		if = {
			limit = {
				current_year >= 1380
				government_type = government_type:monarchy
				OR = {
					country_rank = country_rank:rank_empire
					oe_dyn2_is_byz_mediterranean_sphere = yes
					oe_dyn2_is_sinosphere_realm = yes
				}
				stability >= 15
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_dyn2_cd_ev4 }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_dyn2_cd_ev4 years = 40 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_dyn2.4
		}

		# Event 5: Empress Dowager Behind-the-Curtain Regency Decree
		if = {
			limit = {
				current_year >= 1360
				government_type = government_type:monarchy
				has_consort = yes
				OR = {
					has_regent = yes
					AND = {
						oe_dyn2_is_sinosphere_realm = yes
						country_rank = country_rank:rank_empire
					}
				}
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_dyn2_cd_ev5 }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_dyn2_cd_ev5 years = 30 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_dyn2.5
		}

		# Event 6: Byzantine Senior Co-Emperor Regency Protocol
		if = {
			limit = {
				current_year >= 1355
				government_type = government_type:monarchy
				OR = {
					has_or_had_tag = BYZ
					has_or_had_tag = ROM
					culture = { has_culture_group = culture_group:greek_group }
				}
				OR = {
					has_regent = yes
					has_heir = yes
				}
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_dyn2_cd_ev6 }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_dyn2_cd_ev6 years = 30 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_dyn2.6
		}

		# Event 7: Imperial Privy Regency Council Charter
		if = {
			limit = {
				current_year >= 1375
				government_type = government_type:monarchy
				country_rank = country_rank:rank_empire
				any_cabinet_character = { is_adult = yes }
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_dyn2_cd_ev7 }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_dyn2_cd_ev7 years = 32 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_dyn2.7
		}

		# Event 8: Investiture of the Order of the Double-Headed Phoenix
		if = {
			limit = {
				current_year >= 1370
				oe_dyn2_is_byz_mediterranean_sphere = yes
				religion.group = religion_group:christian
				prestige >= 30
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_dyn2_cd_ev8 }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_dyn2_cd_ev8 years = 45 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_dyn2.8
		}

		# Event 9: Banner of the Imperial Dragon Guard Order
		if = {
			limit = {
				current_year >= 1375
				oe_dyn2_is_sinosphere_realm = yes
				prestige >= 25
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_dyn2_cd_ev9 }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_dyn2_cd_ev9 years = 45 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_dyn2.9
		}

		# Event 10: Oath of the Order of the Crescent Banner
		if = {
			limit = {
				current_year >= 1375
				oe_dyn2_is_turkopersian_realm = yes
				religion.group = religion_group:muslim
				prestige >= 25
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_dyn2_cd_ev10 }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_dyn2_cd_ev10 years = 45 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_dyn2.10
		}

		# Event 11: Disputation of the Sacred Academies (Religious/Philosophical Schools)
		if = {
			limit = {
				current_year >= 1385
				oe_dyn2_has_school_religion = yes
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_dyn2_cd_ev11 }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_dyn2_cd_ev11 years = 35 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_dyn2.11
		}

		# Event 12: Court Language Hegemony (Lingua Franca of Diplomacy)
		if = {
			limit = {
				current_year >= 1400
				OR = {
					court_language = { language_power >= 0.45 }
					culture = { cultural_influence >= 60 }
				}
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_dyn2_cd_ev12 }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_dyn2_cd_ev12 years = 32 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_dyn2.12
		}

		# Event 13: Greco-Latin & Mediterranean Cultural-Language Synthesis
		if = {
			limit = {
				current_year >= 1425
				oe_dyn2_is_byz_mediterranean_sphere = yes
				num_locations >= 25
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_dyn2_cd_ev13 }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_dyn2_cd_ev13 years = 45 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_dyn2.13
		}

		# Event 14: Manchu-Han & Turko-Persian Imperial Cultural Synthesis
		if = {
			limit = {
				current_year >= 1435
				OR = {
					oe_dyn2_is_sinosphere_realm = yes
					oe_dyn2_is_turkopersian_realm = yes
				}
				num_locations >= 25
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_dyn2_cd_ev14 }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_dyn2_cd_ev14 years = 45 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_dyn2.14
		}
	}
}

# =============================================================================
# 3. HELPER EFFECTS FOR RELIGIOUS SCHOOLS & CULTURAL-LANGUAGE SYNTHESIS
# =============================================================================

# Country scope. Adopts the religion-verified oe_dyn2 philosophical school without engine errors.
oe_dyn2_adopt_eligible_school = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = religion
			OR = {
				religion = religion:sunni
				religion = religion:shia
			}
			oe_dyn2_is_turkopersian_realm = yes
		}
		set_religious_school = religious_school:oe_dyn2_school_rumi_adab_hikma
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			exists = religion
			religion = religion:hindu
		}
		set_religious_school = religious_school:oe_dyn2_school_navya_nyaya_logic
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			exists = religion
			OR = {
				religion = religion:sunni
				religion = religion:ibadi
			}
		}
		set_religious_school = religious_school:oe_dyn2_school_qairawan_fiqh_academy
	}
}

# Country scope. Applies Greco-Latin court language refinement & safely merges unmerged primary group if dominant.
oe_dyn2_apply_grecolatin_synthesis = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_or_had_tag = BYZ
				has_or_had_tag = ROM
				culture = { has_culture_group = culture_group:greek_group }
			}
		}
		set_court_language = culture:greek_culture.dialect
	}
	else = {
		set_court_language = dialect:roman_dialect
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_dominant_country_of = culture
			culture = {
				has_any_culture_group = yes
				is_merged_culture_group = no
				any_culture_group = {
					this = culture_group:greek_group
					is_already_merged = no
				}
			}
		}
		merge_culture_group = culture_group:greek_group
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			is_dominant_country_of = culture
			culture = {
				has_any_culture_group = yes
				is_merged_culture_group = no
				any_culture_group = {
					this = culture_group:italian_group
					is_already_merged = no
				}
			}
		}
		merge_culture_group = culture_group:italian_group
	}
}

# Country scope. Applies Manchu-Han or Turko-Persian bilingual court standard & language alignment.
oe_dyn2_apply_eurasian_synthesis = {
	if = {
		limit = { oe_dyn2_is_sinosphere_realm = yes }
		set_court_language = dialect:classical_chinese_language
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_ai = no
				culture = culture:jurchen_culture
			}
			culture = { change_language = dialect:northern_mandarin_dialect }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { oe_dyn2_is_turkopersian_realm = yes }
		set_court_language = culture:farsi_culture.dialect
	}
}
